summary: Arcturus Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose a strategic collaboration with Thermo Fisher Scientific for CDMO and CRO services related to ARCT-032, an mRNA therapeutic for cystic fibrosis. The agreement involves up to $40 million in clinical manufacturing services from Thermo Fisher and up to $40 million in CRO services from PPD. No equity, price per share, premium, or shareholder vote is involved. This is a routine service agreement, not a special situation. The filing does not trigger any event covered by the requested categories.
